components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single high-authority action in a region.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:50px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:12px; padding:0 20px; color:var(--on-primary, #fffdf6); border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:0; background:var(--forest, #173f35); font:750 12px var(--sans, "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); letter-spacing:0.035em; cursor:pointer; transition:color 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background:#0f3028; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--cobalt, #234c9f); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A bordered supporting action that stays visually subordinate.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display:inline-flex; min-height:50px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:0 20px; color:var(--forest, #173f35); border:1px solid var(--line-dark, #9fa89f); border-radius:0; background:transparent; font:750 12px var(--sans, "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); letter-spacing:0.035em; cursor:pointer; transition:color 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color:var(--forest, #173f35); background:var(--forest-light, #dce7df); } .ds-button-secondary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--cobalt, #234c9f); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: A consequential action signaled by coral text and rule, not a filled alarm surface.
components.css: .ds-button-danger { display:inline-flex; min-height:50px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:0 20px; color:var(--coral, #c76043); border:1px solid rgba(199, 96, 67, 0.5); border-radius:0; background:transparent; font:750 12px var(--sans, "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); letter-spacing:0.035em; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-button-danger:hover { background:rgba(199, 96, 67, 0.08); } .ds-button-danger:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-button-danger:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--cobalt, #234c9f); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A square, paper-backed field with an explicit uppercase label.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:8px; color:var(--ink-soft, #4e625b); font-family:var(--sans, "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); } .ds-field span { font-size:10px; font-weight:750; letter-spacing:0.08em; } .ds-field input { box-sizing:border-box; width:100%; height:49px; padding:0 14px; color:var(--ink, #17312a); border:1px solid var(--line, #cec7b8); border-radius:0; background:var(--paper-light, #faf8f2); font:400 14px var(--sans, "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); } .ds-field input:hover { border-color:var(--line-dark, #9fa89f); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color:var(--forest, #173f35); outline:2px solid var(--cobalt, #234c9f); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color:#9a9e96; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: The active shell destination with a quiet green field and coral edge marker.
components.html: ◎YOUR PATTERN
components.css: .ds-nav-item { position:relative; display:grid; grid-template-columns:24px 1fr; min-height:48px; align-items:center; gap:13px; padding:0 12px; color:var(--ink-soft, #4e625b); border-radius:2px; font:600 13px var(--sans, "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); letter-spacing:0.01em; text-decoration:none; transition:color 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-nav-item-active { color:var(--forest, #173f35); background:var(--forest-light, #dce7df); } .ds-nav-item-active::before { position:absolute; left:-18px; width:3px; height:24px; background:var(--coral, #c76043); content:""; } .ds-nav-icon { font-size:20px; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--cobalt, #234c9f); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Metadata Chip
components.description: A square state or locale label that never becomes a pill.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; padding:6px 11px; color:var(--coral, #c76043); border:1px solid var(--coral, #c76043); border-radius:0; background:transparent; font:600 10px var(--sans, "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); letter-spacing:0.08em; text-transform:uppercase; white-space:nowrap; }

components.name: Vellum Panel
components.description: The default flat container, separated by warm transparency and a fine rule.
components.html:
INSPECTABLE EVIDENCE

Calculation map

Facts stay visible without becoming visual noise.
components.css: .ds-panel { box-sizing:border-box; padding:30px; color:var(--ink, #17312a); border:1px solid var(--line, #cec7b8); border-radius:0; background:rgba(250, 248, 242, 0.72); box-shadow:none; } .ds-panel small { color:var(--ink-faint, #7a8781); font:800 10px var(--sans, "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); letter-spacing:0.13em; } .ds-panel h3 { margin:7px 0 0; font:500 27px/1.1 var(--serif, "Iowan Old Style", Georgia, serif); letter-spacing:-0.035em; } .ds-panel p { margin:18px 0 0; color:var(--ink-soft, #4e625b); font:400 14px/1.6 var(--sans, "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); }

components.name: Accuracy Option
components.description: The selected birth-time accuracy row, with one meaningful circular indicator.
components.css: .ds-accuracy-option { position:relative; display:flex; box-sizing:border-box; min-height:74px; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:18px; color:var(--ink, #17312a); border:1px solid var(--line, #cec7b8); border-radius:0; background:var(--paper, #f2efe6); font-family:var(--sans, "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); cursor:pointer; transition:border-color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-accuracy-option-selected { border-color:var(--forest, #173f35); background:var(--forest-light, #dce7df); } .ds-accuracy-option input { position:absolute; opacity:0; } .ds-radio { display:grid; width:15px; height:15px; flex:0 0 15px; place-items:center; border:1px solid var(--line-dark, #9fa89f); border-radius:50%; } .ds-accuracy-option-selected .ds-radio::after { width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--forest, #173f35); content:""; } .ds-accuracy-option strong, .ds-accuracy-option small { display:block; } .ds-accuracy-option strong { margin-bottom:9px; font-size:12px; } .ds-accuracy-option small { color:var(--ink-soft, #4e625b); font:400 12px/1.45 var(--serif, "Iowan Old Style", Georgia, serif); } .ds-accuracy-option input:focus-visible + .ds-radio { outline:2px solid var(--cobalt, #234c9f); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Evidence Drawer
components.description: The signature disclosure for provenance and reproducibility details.
components.css: .ds-evidence { color:var(--ink, #17312a); border:1px solid var(--line, #cec7b8); border-radius:0; background:#e8e3d8; } .ds-evidence summary { display:flex; min-height:82px; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:30px; padding:18px 28px; cursor:pointer; list-style:none; font:600 17px var(--serif, "Iowan Old Style", Georgia, serif); } .ds-evidence summary::-webkit-details-marker { display:none; } .ds-evidence summary small { display:block; margin-bottom:5px; color:var(--ink-faint, #7a8781); font:500 8px var(--mono, Consolas, monospace); letter-spacing:0.1em; } .ds-evidence-toggle { font:500 9px var(--mono, Consolas, monospace); letter-spacing:0.08em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-evidence[open] .ds-evidence-toggle { font-size:0; } .ds-evidence[open] .ds-evidence-toggle::after { font-size:9px; content:"Close"; } .ds-evidence dl { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3, 1fr); margin:0; border-top:1px solid var(--line, #cec7b8); } .ds-evidence dl div { padding:20px 28px; border-right:1px solid var(--line, #cec7b8); } .ds-evidence dt { margin-bottom:8px; color:var(--ink-faint, #7a8781); font:500 8px var(--mono, Consolas, monospace); letter-spacing:0.07em; } .ds-evidence dd { margin:0; font:500 10px var(--mono, Consolas, monospace); } .ds-evidence summary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--cobalt, #234c9f); outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview:
Pattern/Like feels like a calm reading room joined to a precise observational instrument. Warm drafting paper, fine rules, an almost imperceptible grid, and ink-green type create privacy and permanence; the orbital mark and technical annotations make calculation visible without turning the product into cosmic spectacle.

The system is quiet, exacting, and humane. Spacious editorial composition gives interpretation room to breathe, while square controls, monospaced evidence, and explicit states keep every action accountable. Expression comes from typographic scale and disciplined contrast rather than decoration, gloss, or novelty.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper fields with fine structural rules and no decorative shadow stack.
Large, lightly weighted serif headlines paired with compact sans-serif controls.
Monospaced labels and evidence reserved for calculation, provenance, and status.
Observatory Green carries authority; Signal Coral marks consequential change.
Square, deliberate, restrained components with circles reserved for true indicators.

rules.name: The Signal, Not Decoration Rule
rules.body: Signal Coral marks a state, boundary, revision, or consequential action; it does not become a large ambient fill.

rules.name: The Paper Before White Rule
rules.body: Build hierarchy with warm paper tones and transparency. Pure white is not the default canvas.

rules.name: The Focus Is Functional Rule
rules.body: Focus Cobalt exists to make keyboard location unmistakable and must not compete as a second decorative accent.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif explains meaning, sans-serif operates the product, and mono proves what happened. Do not swap their jobs for variety.

rules.name: The Quiet Scale Rule
rules.body: Display type may be large, but it stays lightly weighted and tightly tracked; hierarchy comes from measure and spacing rather than heavy boldness.

rules.name: The Instrument Grid Rule
rules.body: Align content to shared rules, gutters, and baselines so every surface feels observed within the same apparatus.

rules.name: The Collapse by Comprehension Rule
rules.body: Stack a complex region before labels, charts, or controls become too small to understand; never preserve columns merely to preserve a desktop composition.

rules.name: The Flat and Structural Rule
rules.body: A surface earns hierarchy through tone, rule, and placement—not through a floating shadow.

rules.name: The Meaning Earns the Circle Rule
rules.body: Use a circle only for an indicator, orbit, point, or continuous action; never round a rectangular component merely to make it friendlier.

rules.name: The State Must Read Before It Moves Rule
rules.body: Color, label, border, and status copy establish a state first; motion only confirms the transition.

dos: Do build from Drafting Paper, warm tonal layers, and fine Graphite Rules.
Do use serif for interpretation, sans-serif for operation, and mono for evidence.
Do reserve Signal Coral for active edges, revisions, destructive actions, and consequential annotations.
Do keep visible Focus Cobalt outlines and meet the product's WCAG 2.2 AA target.
Do stack dense regions at the established breakpoints before content becomes cramped or illegible.
Do respect reduced-motion preferences by collapsing animation and transition durations.
donts: Don't introduce zodiac kitsch, neon cosmic gradients, or decorative celestial spectacle.
Don't use glossy dashboard cards, ambient drop shadows, glassmorphic layers, or floating surfaces.
Don't turn controls, chips, fields, cards, or navigation rows into pills.
Don't use Focus Cobalt as decorative color or Signal Coral as a broad background wash.
Don't replace inspectable rules and evidence with generic wellness imagery or sign-based filler.
Don't shrink complex charts, grids, or evidence merely to preserve a multi-column layout.
